search.query: | mstats avg("throttle.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("throttle.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("freq_avg_mhz","freq_max_mhz","freq_min_mhz") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value

| mstats avg("throttle.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | search metric_name IN ("*_throttle_count","*_throttle_new") | foreach v* [eval Value=coalesce(Value,<<FIELD>>)] | fields - v* | xyseries _time metric_name Value
